name: Image Studio
tagline: Create watermark-free high-res AI images from a text prompt in about 30 seconds.
description: Image Studio is a credit-based web app for text-to-image generation and AI photo editing. Type a prompt to get a no-watermark, high-resolution image in about 30 seconds, with six size presets and custom sizes from 1024 to 4096 pixels, plus poster, holiday-card, and editor tools. It markets itself as an independent alternative to Bing Image Creator and is not affiliated with Microsoft or Bing.
